notes.title: 🎮 The Parasight devlog number 4 🎮
notes.content:
In this devlog you can see:
- showing a small part of the area and the concept art of the game.

Also, we add some new features to the game like:
-Added many weapon types. ⚔️
-Increasing sound quilt and unique SFXs for some weapons. 🎧
-Improving enemy AI systems. 🔧
-Inserting a unique special ability into almost all weapons. 🗡
